facts.claim: Public transport across Victoria is half price for everyone from 1 June 2026 until 1 January 2027: the full-fare daily cap falls from $11.40 to $5.70. The discount covers trains, trams and buses but excludes SkyBus.

sources.title: vic.gov.au: Public transport now half price for everyone

The discount does not apply to SkyBus.

facts.claim: Transport Victoria's metropolitan myki Money full fares (half-price period): Free Tram Zone free; two hours Zone 1+2 $2.85; daily Zone 1+2 $5.70; weekend and public holiday daily cap $4.00.

facts.claim: Contactless payments (Visa or Mastercard credit or debit cards, phones and smartwatches) work for full-fare travel on all myki-enabled trains, trams and buses, at the same fares as myki; concession card holders keep using myki. Tap off with the same card or device.

facts.claim: The Metro Tunnel's five underground stations (Arden, Parkville, State Library, Town Hall and Anzac) opened to passengers on 30 November 2025. Underground concourses link State Library to Melbourne Central and Town Hall to Flinders Street, about a four-minute walk each.
